quirks.description: Opt-in quirks the workflow selected (`generic/patterns/quirks/`); each module checks its own value.

skewed.description: A scan set a little off level breaks each long horizontal rule into pieces a pixel row apart (国分寺市): the pieces are joined end to end before a rule's length is checked, and the words of one printed line are grouped with a wider tolerance (a line's amount at the right end sits up to 2.5pt above its name at the left).

row_gaps.description: A vertical rule the page leaves out for a row lets the row's text run on into the next column (133086's 事業 names): an OCR line is cut only at the rules drawn across its middle.

short_columns.description: A column rule drawn only over one short row (shorter than the page-wide detector keeps) is still a rule: a short vertical stroke joining two horizontal rules at the place of a vertical rule the page draws elsewhere closes the cell, as in a staircase (131199's 目 rows between 事務事業 blocks).

row_columns.description: A narrow stroke that runs the whole height between two horizontal rules is a column rule even where the page draws no rule at that place elsewhere (131164's 財源 columns under 説明, drawn only over a 目's row in the middle of a page).

lines.description: One cell stacks the item's amounts a line each, the later ones in brackets (国分寺市: `1,147,465` / `(1,110,941)` / `(36,524)` under `本年度 (前年度) (比較)`): the heading of each line, top to bottom.

line_pitch.description: The distance in points from one stacked line (`lines`) to the next, where the lines stand further apart than their height (国立市: 10pt figures 14pt apart). Without it a line is taken to be .82 of the name's height below the one above.

excluded.description: The column is not taken in: the builder reads none of it, and its printed digits are a coverage exclusion of the whole column on every page, with a kind of the shared vocabulary and the reason.

overhang.description: Points the text layer sets the column's digits past its right rule (a font the PDF does not embed, 小笠原村): they are still the column's.

open_frame.description: No rule closes the table at its top or foot, and the 款・項 columns rule only the rows that open a 款・項 (八丈町 R6): a column counts with one row rule, and the frame runs from where its side rules start to where they end.

carried.description: Only the first page of a run prints the column headings (八丈町 R6): a frame drawn with the same column rules as a frame read before it, whose top prints fewer than half of its heading words, takes its headings and is body from its top rule.

staircase.description: The subject columns are a staircase: one header cell 款 項 目 over narrow code columns, and the 款・項 cells run down the page with no closing rule. "款項目節" also reads a header cell 款 項 目 節 over four columns, the fourth being 節.

agree_on_bottom.description: Scan: the agreed header reading is moved onto each page aligned on the header's bottom rule, not the frame's top (a frame boxing the page title above the header on some pages).

merged_cells.description: Header cells (`説明`) whose columns are ruled only in some rows: in a row their rules leave out, one cell runs across them and its words are read as one column under the header cell.

agree_all_frames.description: Scan: every frame of a spread (not only the widest) takes the header reading most pages share, frame by frame from the left.

kind_by_characters.description: A stacked kind under its group whose two printed lines the text layer or OCR read across (翌年度繰越額／継逓繰続費次越) is the known kind its characters spell, not the group (headers.canonical).

facing_pages.description: The layout pattern `running_titles`: a page without a subject column is the right half of the spread opened by the page before it with one, whatever horizontal rules each prints (東久留米市: the left page rules each 目, the right page each line of the 説明).

opening.description: The layout pattern `running_titles` with `carried_names`: a volume that begins inside a 目 repeats it first (`15515(高齢者福祉費)`); the 款・項・目 its codes are, with the names the volume before prints, open the volume as titles.

carried_names.description: The layout pattern `running_titles`: the first line of a page's subject column that only repeats the open 目, its codes and its name in brackets with no amount in its row (`10 5 40 (企画調整費)`, 調布市), opens no item.

title_amount.description: The heading of the amount a 款・項 title prints with no heading over it (`1款 総務費 24,930,655千円`, the layout pattern `stacked_titles`).

character_map.description: Explicit Unicode mapping for broken font maps, before XML parsing and glyph reconstruction.

form_clips.description: Text drawn inside a form has its clip in the form's space: an object whose own bounds meet it is visible.

image_rules.description: A page that draws no vector rule has its ruled grid in a background image: the rules are read from the render, as a scan's are.

crop_box.description: Each page shows one half of a sheet printed two pages up through its CropBox (131211): the words and rules outside it are the other page's, observed as that page.

quirks.description: Opt-in quirks the workflow selected (`generic/patterns/quirks/`); each module checks its own value.

name_start_slack.description: Points past the usual 3 a wrapped line may stand from the name's start, where a long number and the blank after it are not as wide as the estimate.

yen_marked.description: An amount that prints 円 after it in a column of another unit is in yen: a reckoning (`46.4円 × 1,115,000件 ＝ 51,736,000円`) set among the column's 千円.
